title: Materials Around Me
text:
This is a wooden chair. Wood is hard and brown. My bed has a soft blanket made of wool. Wool feels warm and soft.

My cup is made of glass. The glass is smooth and cold. Be careful, because glass can break. The stone path in the garden is rough.

questions.text: What is the chair made of?
What is the cup made of?
Why should you be careful with the cup?
options: Because it is made of wool

questions.text: Which material would feel best on a cold night?

vocabulary.definition: the hard material that trees are made of
flat, with no bumps or rough parts
not smooth; has bumps or uneven parts
a hard, clear material that can break

paragraph_translations: Esta es una silla de madera. La madera es dura y marrón. Mi cama tiene una manta suave hecha de lana. La lana se siente cálida y suave.
Mi taza está hecha de vidrio. El vidrio es liso y frío. Ten cuidado, porque el vidrio puede romperse. El camino de piedra del jardín es áspero.
